title: ActionRequestedParams
description: The user clicked an action. Only sent for trusted clicks. state is the toolbar's state when the user came to it: collapsed when they came to it as the chip, even though pointing at the chip expands it.

actionId.description: An action's id, or "ask" for the built-in Ask.

parameter.description: The chosen option's value, for actions with a parameter.

sourceLanguage.description: The page's language tag for the selection, from the nearest lang attribute. Only sent for language parameters.

placement.description: Where the action was picked: a toolbar button (Ask included), or the more menu. A choice inherits its action's placement.

editable.description: Whether the selection is in an editable field.
